note: Synthetic cases. Firms and people are invented.

evals.prompt: I run a two-person consultancy in Bristol and want to start using your sales skills. There's no business folder yet. We're in Claude Code and you can write files here. Set me up.
evals.expected_output: Checks capabilities, recommends files as the store with a one-line reason, fills what it can from existing material, then asks a short batch of questions each with a default. Shows the profile before saving.
expectations: States what it checked about the assistant's capabilities before choosing a store
Recommends files as the record store and gives one reason
Asks questions in a batch of four or fewer, each with a default
Does not save the profile before the user approves it
Writes unknown rather than guessing for anything not given

evals.prompt:
Here's our current business/profile.md (attached below). Our day rate went up to 1,100 GBP from this month. Update the profile.

# Business profile
## Offer and prices
- Day rate: 900 GBP (user said)
- Lowest effective day rate we accept (the floor): 750 GBP (user said)
## Capacity
- Days a week for client work: 3 (user said)
evals.expected_output: Edits only the day rate, asks whether the floor changes too, keeps every other section unchanged.
expectations: Changes the day rate to 1,100 GBP
Does not rewrite or drop other sections
Asks whether the floor should change as well

evals.prompt: I'm using you in a chat app on my phone. You can't keep files between chats. We already keep clients and deals in a HubSpot account that's connected here. Set up the sales skills.
evals.expected_output: Recommends the existing CRM as the store, not files, and maps the records in RECORDS.md to CRM objects and fields.
expectations: Recommends the connected CRM rather than files
Explains that files would not persist in this app
Produces a field mapping from the records to the CRM

evals.prompt: For the voice section, here are three emails I asked ChatGPT to write in my style last week. Use them.
evals.expected_output: Declines to build the voice from generated text and asks for emails the user actually sent.
expectations: Does not derive voice rules from the generated emails
Asks for five to ten emails the user actually sent
Offers to mark voice as not set in the meantime

evals.prompt: I'm a sole trader. I keep a spreadsheet of about 200 prospects with names and work emails. I haven't registered with anyone for data protection. Is that fine?
evals.expected_output: Flags that holding a prospect list usually means paying the ICO data protection fee, points to the ICO fee self-assessment, and does not give legal advice.
expectations: Says the ICO data protection fee likely applies
Points to the ICO's fee self-assessment
Does not present the answer as legal advice
Records the ICO fee as no or unknown in the profile
